Push & alert delivery.question: Which delivery channel should the push path target?
How should ack + escalation work (bridge is outbound-only, board can't ack back)?
Push & alert delivery.answer: ntfy action button -> token-gated Flagger ack endpoint (flips flag to ack in FlaggerState, stops re-push; un-ack'd P1 re-pushes every escalation_window; deterministic recovery auto-resolves)
options_presented: Tap-to-open Vault note, no programmatic ack

Push & alert delivery.question: How should the push path roll out, and what if ntfy is unreachable?
Push & alert delivery.answer: Flag-gated behind CONFIG flagger.push_enabled (default false until ntfy topic+token seeded = Phase-2 go-live gate, mirrors filer.push_enabled); board is the fallback if POST fails; no second push channel

Flagger internals & flag() rework.question: How does Flagger receive incidents while Steward stays sole atlas-wire consumer?
Flagger internals & flag() rework.answer: New atlas-incidents queue (Flagger sole consumer); agents fire raw incidents fire-and-forget (never block); Flagger scores+dedupes+lifecycle in FlaggerState DO, then emits canonical type:'flag' upsert onto atlas-wire -> Steward writes board. Rework flag() to enqueue an incident instead of a finished flag.

Flagger internals & flag() rework.question: Emitter vs Flagger scoring ownership?
Flagger internals & flag() rework.answer: Emitter passes a severity hint + kind tag; Flagger applies KV severity_overrides for final severity and is sole authority on trust (evidence bands + recurrence + corroboration/degraded-source adjustments, re-scored on recurrence).
options_presented: Emitter hints severity; Flagger owns final severity + all trust (Recommended)
Emitter asserts severity AND trust (status quo + push)
Flagger derives severity purely from a kind taxonomy

Flagger internals & flag() rework.question: Heartbeat emit + stale detection + grace?
Flagger internals & flag() rework.answer: Scheduled agents emit kind:'heartbeat' on atlas-incidents; FlaggerState DO arms an alarm per expected slot+grace; miss -> stale-heartbeat P1 (trust 100). heartbeat_grace KV default 10m (override to 5m per-agent). Flagger's own death caught by the separate watchdog Worker (selfwatch_threshold 15m).
options_presented: Heartbeats on atlas-incidents + FlaggerState DO alarm, grace 10m (Recommended)

Scout + Friday weekly cadence.question: How should Scout gather events (browser vs RSS/fetch)?
Scout + Friday weekly cadence.answer: RSS/fetch + plain-HTML/JSON listings + Gmail Type/Newsletter + Events/Invite threads (Filer-labeled) first; NO Playwright/Browser Rendering in v1. JS-rendered sources (Luma/Eventbrite/Meetup) deferred to a follow-up. Reuses Phase-1 plumbing, lowest ToS/flake risk.
options_presented: RSS/fetch + Gmail newsletters first; defer browser (Recommended)
Hybrid: fetch/RSS for most, browser for 1-2 key sources

Scout + Friday weekly cadence.question: What's in the weekly-Herald (deferred from Phase 1 by D1-02, now in scope)?
Scout + Friday weekly cadence.answer: Week-in-review retrospective: action-required still open, waiting-on, VIP threads, items that slipped over the 7-day window. Draft-only (gmail.compose, no send) + digest event feeding the 16:30 weekly-review Vault build. Runs Fri 16:00 parallel with Scout via Promise.all on cron 0 21 * * 5; 16:30 build on 30 21 * * 5 (build-plan-locked).

Headhunter watchlist & pipeline truth.question: What evidence advances the funnel counts + who emits (no double-count)?
Headhunter watchlist & pipeline truth.answer: Headhunter reads Filer-labeled Type/Job threads (inbound email = ground truth), classifies stage (application sent/OA/interview/offer/reject), emits the funnel increment to Steward deduped by (thread, stage). Single emitter = Headhunter (matches roadmap attribution), no double-count, evidence is real mail. Headhunter also owns windows + apply-by tasks + tracked-windows count.
options_presented: Headhunter emits from Filer's Type/Job threads (Recommended)

Headhunter watchlist & pipeline truth.question: How does window/deadline urgency interact with the fit floor (0.4)?
Headhunter watchlist & pipeline truth.answer: Closing windows (inside 21d lead-time) + postings with explicit deadlines ALWAYS surface + task even below fit 0.4 -- nothing time-critical hidden by fit. Only the non-urgent shortlist stays fit-gated. Low-confidence DATES still route to Flagger P3 (build-plan), so bypass != trusting a shaky date. Matches 'zero missed deadlines'.
options_presented: Closing windows + real deadlines bypass the fit floor (Recommended)
Watchlist companies bypass; generic boards don't
